############################################################################################
# HOD operations: the war happens in operations aimed at a few planets (the "theater").
# - Between operations there is peace and the hyperlanes are open as usual.
# - An operation closes every hyperlane except the ones that touch its objective states (state flag
#   HOD_theater; rules in map/adjacency_rules.txt, generated by tools/hoi4_country_editor/gen_hyperlanes.py),
#   declares the war, and gives both sides a mission timer.
# - It ends when the attacker holds every objective (victory: the objectives are transferred)
#   or when the timer runs out (the defender held). Then every country at war makes white
#   peace, so anything taken outside the objectives returns to its owner.
#
# To add an operation: copy HOD_operation_geonosis_start, give it a new HOD_op_number,
# its objective states, its attacker and defender, and a name in HOD_operations.txt (scripted loc).
############################################################################################

# Scope: the attacking country (REP or CIS). Before calling, fill global.HOD_op_targets with the objective states.
HOD_operation_start = {
	set_global_flag = HOD_op_active
	clr_global_flag = HOD_op_won
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.HOD_op_targets
		set_state_flag = HOD_theater
	}
	if = {
		limit = { tag = REP }
		set_global_flag = HOD_op_by_REP
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = CIS } }
			declare_war_on = { target = CIS type = annex_everything }
		}
	}
	else = {
		clr_global_flag = HOD_op_by_REP
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = REP } }
			declare_war_on = { target = REP type = annex_everything }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				tag = REP
				is_in_faction_with = REP
				tag = CIS
				is_in_faction_with = CIS
			}
		}
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = HOD_operation_no_surrender }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { tag = REP tag = CIS } }
		country_event = { id = hod_operations.1 }
	}
}

# Scope: the attacker (its mission completed: it holds every objective).
HOD_operation_victory = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = HOD_op_active }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.HOD_op_targets
			if = {
				limit = { is_controlled_by = ROOT }
				ROOT = { transfer_state = PREV }
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = HOD_op_won
		HOD_operation_end = yes
	}
}

# Any scope: the timer ran out, the defender held.
HOD_operation_failure = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = HOD_op_active }
		clr_global_flag = HOD_op_won
		HOD_operation_end = yes
	}
}

# Any scope: peace for every pair of countries at war across the two sides, close the lanes, start the cooldown.
HOD_operation_end = {
	clr_global_flag = HOD_op_active
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { tag = REP is_in_faction_with = REP } }
		every_enemy_country = { white_peace = PREV }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.HOD_op_targets
		clr_state_flag = HOD_theater
	}
	clear_array = global.HOD_op_targets
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = HOD_operation_no_surrender } }
		remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = HOD_operation_no_surrender }
	}
	set_global_flag = { flag = HOD_op_cooldown days = 35 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { tag = REP tag = CIS } }
		country_event = { id = hod_operations.2 }
	}
}

############################################################################################
# Operation 1: Battle of Geonosis. The Republic attacks Geonosis (state 35), 70 days.
# Started by Clone_wars_start, i.e. this is the opening of the Clone Wars.
############################################################################################
HOD_operation_geonosis_start = {
	set_variable = { global.HOD_op_number = 1 }
	clear_array = global.HOD_op_targets
	35 = { add_to_array = { global.HOD_op_targets = THIS } }
	set_global_flag = HOD_op_geonosis
	REP = {
		HOD_operation_start = yes
		activate_mission = HOD_op_attack_70
	}
	CIS = { activate_mission = HOD_op_defend_70 }
}
